title: 第23章 凝神果第24章 水中艳遇
content_zh:
萧天继续沿着太阳升起的方向前行。
又过了一会儿，萧天听到有水流的声音，一般有水的地方危险性也高。
同样的珍贵的药材和高级的妖兽也会增多。
一路前行，这里植物长得高大，每一棵大树都有二十几丈高。
抬头望去，好像看不到顶一样。
周围的灌木丛生，旁边好像随时可能窜出妖兽来。
萧天小心翼翼的现在搜寻着。
突然，萧天发现前方不远的一个先土坡上有一棵高三四丈的树，树上结着几棵果子。
那果子远远望去，只见长得晶莹剔透，周身灵气环绕，个头也有着两个拳头大。
一时间萧天没认出来是什么。
于是想开口向逆天珠请教。
只是还没开口，逆天珠诧异的道“这里灵气匮乏，居然也能长出凝神果。”
听到这话萧天好奇的问“逆天珠前辈，这凝神果有什么神奇的地方。”
“凝神果，顾名思义，就是可以随时可以凝炼神识，不受修为限制，并且可以提高神识的纯度和强度，从而提高神识探查的范围。
这可是已经到了地阶初级灵验行列了。
一般都是生长在比这里灵气充沛十倍不止的地方…”
逆天珠解释道
听到逆天珠所说，萧天也是震惊不已。
首先这果子居然达到了地阶灵药。
灵药也是分普通灵药，玄阶灵药，地阶灵药，以及天阶灵药。

这一路上萧天得到的都是一些普通灵药。
而现在所看到的居然是地阶灵药，可见其珍贵了！
其次是这灵果居然可以让修炼者提前开神识。
在没有神识前我们就是通过视觉、触觉、嗅觉感知事物。
而神识是通过意念去感知事物，具有速度快，范围广，如果修为高于对方，还可以不被发现，等诸多优点。
一般正常的情况下，只有结丹后才有可能开劈神识成功。
因为开神识需要在脑海中开辟一个意念空间。
这个过程是非常痛苦的，同时需要强大的修为支撑这个过程。
而且整个过程不能停止，一旦中途停止，会直接导致脑海里受力不均，从而脑海破碎。
那么这样的结果就是修炼者变成了傻子。
这也就是我们常说“修炼都修炼傻了”
的由来。
而有了凝神果不就相当于开挂吗？同等级别的人还没有神识的时候你已经开启了。
这优势简直就是让人嫉妒到癫狂！
知道有如此强大效果，萧天直接就运用了功法《无相流影诀》中的无相掠影。
身如闪电般冲出。
同时，也是随时准备攻击。
这山脉的灵药都会有守护妖兽，这么高级的灵药怎么会没有呢！
所以萧天打算，先利用身法优势，出其不意的把灵果抢到手。
然后逃之夭夭。

二十丈、十丈、五丈……
眨眼间已经来到第一颗凝神果前面，然后迅雷不及掩耳摘下，然后继续下一颗……
在连续摘下了五颗后，一声鹰啸声从树干中传出来。
这声鹰啸声震耳欲聋，充满愤怒之意，远远传了出去！
正在后面追击而来的李家众人也是听到了这恐怖的声音。
content_en:
Xiao Tian continued to move in the direction of the rising sun.
After a while, Xiao Tian heard the sound of water flowing. Generally, places with water are more dangerous.
The same precious medicinal materials and high-level monsters will also increase.
Along the way, the plants here grow tall, and each big tree is more than twenty feet tall.
Looking up, it seems like I can't see the top.
The surrounding bushes are thick, and it seems that monsters may emerge from the surroundings at any time.
Xiao Tian carefully searched now.
Suddenly, Xiao Tian found a tree three or four feet high on an ancient slope not far ahead, with several fruits on the tree.
Looking at the fruit from a distance, one can see that it is crystal clear, surrounded by spiritual energy, and is as big as two fists.
Xiao Tian didn't recognize what it was for a moment.
So I wanted to ask Ni Tianzhu for advice.
But before he spoke, Ni Tianzhu said in surprise, "There is a lack of spiritual energy here, but the Condensation Fruit can actually grow."
Upon hearing this, Xiao Tian curiously asked, "Senior Nitianzhu, what's so magical about this Condensation Fruit?"
"The Fruit of Condensation, as the name suggests, means that you can condense your spiritual consciousness at any time, without being restricted by your cultivation level, and it can improve the purity and intensity of your spiritual consciousness, thus increasing the scope of your spiritual consciousness exploration.
This has reached the rank of primary efficacious person at the earth level.
Usually they grow in places with more than ten times more spiritual energy than here..."
Ni Tianzhu explained
Xiao Tian was also shocked when he heard what Ni Tianzhu said.
First of all, this fruit actually reaches the level of earth-level elixir.
The elixirs are also divided into ordinary elixirs, mysterious level elixirs, earth level elixirs, and heaven level elixirs.
What Xiao Tian got along the way were some ordinary elixirs.
But what we see now is actually an earth-level elixir, which shows how precious it is!
Secondly, this spiritual fruit can actually allow cultivators to open their spiritual consciousness in advance.
Before we had spiritual consciousness, we perceived things through sight, touch, and smell.
Divine consciousness perceives things through thoughts. It has many advantages such as fast speed and wide range. If the cultivation level is higher than that of the opponent, it can not be discovered, etc.
Under normal circumstances, it is only possible to successfully open the spiritual consciousness after forming a pill.
Because opening up spiritual consciousness requires opening up a space of thought in the mind.
This process is very painful and requires strong cultivation to support this process.
And the whole process cannot be stopped. Once it is stopped in the middle, it will directly lead to uneven force in the mind, which will cause the mind to be broken.
The result is that practitioners become fools.
This is why we often say, “cultivation makes you stupid”
The origin of.
And wouldn’t having the Concentration Fruit be equivalent to cheating? You have already opened it before people of the same level have spiritual consciousness.
This advantage simply makes people jealous to the point of madness!
Knowing that it had such a powerful effect, Xiao Tian directly used the phaseless glimmering shadow in the "Phaseless Flowing Shadow Technique".
The body rushed out like lightning.
At the same time, he is also ready to attack at any time.
The elixirs in this mountain range will all have guardian monsters. How could there not be such a high-level elixir!
So Xiao Tian planned to take advantage of his body skills to grab the spirit fruit by surprise.
Then run away.
Twenty feet, ten feet, five feet...
In the blink of an eye, I had arrived in front of the first concentration fruit, and then I picked it off at lightning speed, and then moved on to the next one...
After picking five in a row, an eagle whistle came from the tree trunk.
The roar of the eagle was deafening, full of anger, and spread far away!
The members of the Li family who were chasing after him also heard this terrifying sound.
